newsitem.title: USA: Detroit & Canada Tunnel to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: Detroit & Canada Tunnel to be acquired.

text.p: Detroit & Canada Tunnel Corp said on Monday it had signed a preliminary agreement to be acquired for $54 a share by a joint venture between Hyde Park Holdings Inc and a major insurance and investment company.
Detroit & Canada Tunnel, which operates the toll tunnel that connects Detroit to Windsor, Ontario, has 676,027 shares outstanding, making the deal worth about $36.5 million.
The parties declined to identify the insurance company involved in the deal.
Hyde Park Holding is a 10-year-old investment firm based in New York.

The cash transaction is subject to execution of a definitive agreement, shareholder approval and other conditions. If a definitive merger agreement is reached, a closing is expected in January, Detroit & Canada Tunnel said.
The company said no changes in management or operations were contemplated.
